states.name: initial_workbench
states.description: Scene loaded with both models on pedestals, empty reaction vessel, default temperature and pressure

states.name: avocado_loaded
states.description: Avocado substrate dragged into reaction vessel, sunglasses still on pedestal
states.condition: window.__3D_STATE__ && window.__3D_STATE__.avocadoInVessel === true && window.__3D_STATE__.sunglassesInVessel === false && window.__3D_STATE__.fragmentCount === 0

states.name: both_reactants_loaded
states.description: Both avocado and sunglasses inside vessel, ready for parameter adjustment
states.condition: window.__3D_STATE__ && window.__3D_STATE__.avocadoInVessel === true && window.__3D_STATE__.sunglassesInVessel === true && window.__3D_STATE__.bondsAreBroken === false && window.__3D_STATE__.fragmentCount === 0

states.name: parameters_configured
states.description: Temperature set to 450K and pressure set to 7 atm for optimal reaction conditions
states.condition: window.__3D_STATE__ && window.__3D_STATE__.avocadoInVessel === true && window.__3D_STATE__.sunglassesInVessel === true && window.__3D_STATE__.temperatureKelvin > 400 && window.__3D_STATE__.pressureAtm > 5 && window.__3D_STATE__.bondsAreBroken === false

states.name: bonds_broken
states.description: Molecular bonds broken, 6 fragments floating in vessel with red glow effect
states.condition: window.__3D_STATE__ && window.__3D_STATE__.bondsAreBroken === true && window.__3D_STATE__.fragmentCount === 6 && window.__3D_STATE__.massConserved === false

states.name: mass_conserved
states.description: Mass conservation verified and displayed, system in stable post-reaction state
states.condition: window.__3D_STATE__ && window.__3D_STATE__.bondsAreBroken === true && window.__3D_STATE__.fragmentCount === 6 && window.__3D_STATE__.massConserved === true

states.name: stability_verified
states.description: 60-second stability run completed with all fragments and mass data persistent
states.condition: window.__3D_STATE__ && window.__3D_STATE__.bondsAreBroken === true && window.__3D_STATE__.fragmentCount === 6 && window.__3D_STATE__.massConserved === true

action.code: const avocado = window.scene.children.find(c => c.userData.name === 'avocado' || c.userData.type === 'substrate'); if (avocado) { avocado.position.set(0, 0.5, 0); window.__3D_STATE__.avocadoInVessel = true; }

postconditions: Avocado model positioned inside reaction vessel
avocadoInVessel state flag set to true

action.code: const sunglasses = window.scene.children.find(c => c.userData.name === 'sunglasses' || c.userData.type === 'catalyst'); if (sunglasses) { sunglasses.position.set(0, 0.8, 0); window.__3D_STATE__.sunglassesInVessel = true; }

postconditions: Sunglasses model positioned inside reaction vessel
sunglassesInVessel state flag set to true

action.code: const tempSlider = document.querySelector('input[type="range"][min="200"]'); if (tempSlider) { tempSlider.value = 450; tempSlider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); } const pressSlider = document.querySelector('input[type="range"][min="1"]'); if (pressSlider) { pressSlider.value = 7; pressSlider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); }

postconditions: Reaction parameters configured for bond breaking
